assessments: All seven helpers parse, and their ASTs are identical to the reviewed round106 implementations after only explicit round/date/base substitutions. Correct new worktree, branch, trusted base, receipts and output directories were independently read; no stale round106/base literal remains in the scoped files.

The actual provisional configuration has empty counts and a pending status. Pure guard tests verify that this status rejects both commit and push before mutation. Actual measured counts and matching terminal receipts remain a required later binding step.

Commit gates require terminal batch commands in exact order, successful native review check, log digests, current exact owner hashes and coverage counts, then an allowlisted staged scope and clean tree. Push checks exact head/tree/parent, branch, repository origin, unchanged configuration/guard hashes and fresh remote main before pushing.

Isolated verification writes only to new timestamped temporary clone/archive/log/receipt paths, validates exact squash tree and trusted parent, fetches retained tags, and checks topic absence. Project environment commands run in the new clone. Original main preservation helper performs only reads and writes a fresh receipt; no environment synchronization, reset or deletion targets main.

Coverage enumeration includes hidden/ignored entries and follows relevant symlinks with cycle prevention. Acceptance needs completed positive scientific reviews tied to target ID/path, reviewed scope and exact bytes, together with available review bases. Canonical native review validation remains a separate required gate.

Review-base enumeration retains all available revisions and verifies the known non-ancestral published tag remotely. New review bases for this round are the retained trusted main base; future novel non-ancestral bases would need explicit retained remote provenance and isolated verification.
